lua: PREVIEW.chain_text=function() local text=''; for _,run in ipairs(PREVIEW_PY.hud_runs()) do text=text..run.text end; return text end; assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain ~0:38','Local timing was not a single marked estimate')
assert(PREVIEW.tip=='','Chain tooltip appeared before the hover delay')

assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('EXP chain timer (estimated)',1,true),'Chain tooltip did not mark the estimate'); assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('~0:38',1,true),'Tooltip lost its marked estimate'); assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('This timer uses Phoenix EXP chain rules',1,true),'Tooltip did not identify Phoenix rules'); PREVIEW.view.chain_left_min=10; PREVIEW.view.chain_estimated=true
assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain ~0:38','Legacy fields added a range to the estimate')
assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain ~0:38','Local timing was not a single marked estimate')

assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('This timer uses Phoenix EXP chain rules',1,true),'Local timing did not identify its Phoenix rules'); assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('shortest possible time',1,true),'Local timing did not explain the conservative window'); assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('when the reward arrives',1,true),'Local timing did not explain receipt anchoring'); assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('~0:38',1,true),'Local tooltip lost its estimate marker'); PREVIEW.view.chain_source='unknown'

assert(PREVIEW.view.chain_left==38 and PREVIEW.view.chain_left_min==10,'The stale numeric fixture was not retained'); assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain --','Unknown timing reused stale numeric fields')

assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('waiting for an EXP chain reward',1,true),'Unavailable timing did not explain the required observation'); assert(not PREVIEW.tip:find('0:38',1,true),'Unavailable tooltip retained the stale countdown'); PREVIEW.view.chain_source='local'; PREVIEW.view.chain_left=nil
assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain --','Expired local estimate invented time remaining')

assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('estimated timer has ended',1,true),'Local expiry did not explain its state'); assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('EXP chain may still be active',1,true),'Conservative expiry was presented as an actual chain end')
assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain --','Expired local estimate invented time remaining')
assert(not PREVIEW.tip:find('No EXP chain is active',1,true),'Local expiry claimed the actual chain was over'); PREVIEW.view.chain_left=38
assert(PREVIEW.chain_text()=='Next chain ~0:38','Renewed local timing did not resume its marked estimate')
assert(PREVIEW.tip:find('This timer uses Phoenix EXP chain rules',1,true) and PREVIEW.tip:find('~0:38',1,true),'Renewed local tooltip did not refresh')
